meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu – International Company (IC) Programme, Port Vila, Efate
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid – English common law foundation with residual French civil law influence and recognition of customary 'kastom' law
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER-Plus, 2017)
No comprehensive double taxation agreement generally applicable; International Companies benefit from domestic statutory tax exemption

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Proliferation Financing Act No. 51 of 2015 [CAP 261], as amended by the Anti-Money Laundering and Proliferation Financing (Amendment) Acts of 2022; International Companies Act No. 32 of 1993 [CAP 222], as amended, beneficial ownership provisions ss. 42A–42C; Companies Act No. 8 of 1986 [CAP 191], as amended; Registered Agents and Trustees Licensing Act No. 21 of 2000 [CAP 242]; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) AML/CFT Guidelines; Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) directives and targeted financial sanctions regulations implementing UN Security Council resolutions.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies Registry

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association (certified copy)
Certificate of Incumbency / Register of Directors

Registered Agent's Certificate and Consent to Act

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation CDD screening of all proposed directors, shareholders, and beneficial owners by the licensed registered agent against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated List, UK OFSI List, and domestic Vanuatu designations issued by the Financial Intelligence Unit. Foreign and domestic PEPs, family members, and close associates trigger mandatory enhanced due diligence under ss. 17–18 of the AML/CFT Act [CAP 261], including senior management approval, source-of-wealth verification, and ongoing transaction monitoring. Screening results must be evidenced, retained for at least five years post-termination, and refreshed on a continuing risk-sensitive basis in accordance with VFSC AML/CFT Guidelines.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: VFSC Companies Registry – International Companies online name clearance and incorporation filing, effected exclusively through VFSC-licensed Registered Agents
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: IC names must be expressed in Latin (Roman) script. Official company languages for statutory filings are English and French, with Bislama nominally available; names originating in non-Roman scripts must be transliterated into Roman script, and the Roman-script form is the definitive legal name. The name must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Corporation', or another recognized limited-liability suffix and must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant, through its licensed registered agent, must submit a written reconsideration request to the VFSC Registrar of Companies within 14 days of the rejection notice, stating the grounds of objection, evidence of entitlement to the proposed name, consents from any holder of a similar mark, and the requested name modification. The Registrar must issue a written determination within 21 days of receipt. If the reconsideration is denied, the applicant may file an originating application in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu for judicial review within 28 days of the determination, per the Civil Procedure Rules. An approved name reservation may, upon written request before expiry, be renewed for one additional 30-day period against an additional statutory fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted for the statutory registered office. Every International Company must maintain a physical registered office address in Vanuatu and a VFSC-licensed registered agent at that address under the International Companies Act [CAP 222]. Virtual or digital-only addresses are non-compliant; however, a pure e-commerce cosplay apparel operation using Stripe and Shopify Payments creates no additional requirement of physical trading premises or commercial substance in Vanuatu, and the licensed agent's physical address satisfies the statutory presence rule.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low – approximately 5% annualised probability. VFSC supervisory and AML/CFT on-site inspections are directed principally at licensed registered agents and financial institutions, not at the premises of tax-exempt International Companies that maintain no physical operations in Vanuatu. Unannounced inspections of the IC's registered office address are rare and, where triggered, follow agent-specific risk-based monitoring rather than routine company inspections.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 17 of 1992, Chapter 222, as amended (International Companies (Amendment) Acts 1994-2014); sites of principal operations: ss.4-6 (incorporation), s.10 (Certificate of Incorporation), s.11 (registered office), ss.21-23 (registered agent), ss.86-92 (directors and secretary); International Companies and Trusts (Fees) Regulations 2010; Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Rules 2019.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registry of International Companies, Port Vila.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 'Application for Registration as an International Company', accompanied by the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association and registered agent's consent; Certificate of Incorporation is issued under s.10 upon VFSC approval.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum authorized or paid-up capital is prescribed for a Vanuatu International Company; the sole founding subscriber may subscribe for one ordinary share of par value USD 1.00 or an equivalent in any freely convertible currency. No escrow bank account or capital deposit is required at incorporation; the share capital requirement is nil and shares may be issued fully or partly paid. Beneficial ownership particulars, including the subscriber shareholding, must be declared to the VFSC within 14 days of incorporation in accordance with the Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Rules 2019.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT the incorporation of the Company under the International Companies Act 1992, as evidenced by the Certificate of Incorporation dated [DATE], be ratified, and the filed Memorandum and Articles of Association be adopted as the Company's constitution. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the subscription by the founding subscriber for one Ordinary Share of USD 1.00 be approved, the share register opened immediately, and allotment of issued shares authorized upon completion of the beneficial ownership declaration. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the registered office at the licensed Registered Agent's offices in Port Vila, Vanuatu, be designated as the Company's registered office, and the Registered Agent's consent to act be recorded. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT [DIRECTOR] be appointed sole Director and [SECRETARY] be appointed Company Secretary, each empowered to execute bank mandates, tax filings, and commercial agreements.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Search and Reservation with the VFSC International Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Registry of International Companies, through a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a VFSC-licensed registered agent and submit up to three proposed English-language names for availability screening. Ensure no name contains restricted words such as 'Trust', 'Bank', 'Insurance' or 'Assurance' unless a dedicated sector license is separately obtained. The agent lodges a name reservation request with the VFSC and obtains written clearance before the incorporation application is filed. The selected name must be sufficiently distinguishable from names already on the VFSC register.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name and two alternates
Registered agent's name reservation request letter
Registered agent engagement letter and AML/KYC pack for the beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity to an existing register entry, resubmit with a distinguishing word or geographical qualifier. If refused for a restricted word, remove the word or obtain the appropriate sector license and re-file. A no-fee resubmission is accepted once within the VFSC's prescribed query period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed Registered Agent, with notarial or witnessing formalities completed before lodgment.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent prepares the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English in accordance with the statutory model in the First Schedule of the International Companies Act 1992. The founding subscriber signs the memorandum in the presence of an adult witness; the subscriber's signature is witnessed by a notary public or commissioner of oaths. The agent executes its consent to act as registered agent and issues a statement of compliance confirming that all statutory formalities have been met.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association with subscriber clause and objects
Articles of Association regulating share classes, directors, and meetings
Consent to act as Registered Agent
AML/KYC verification pack of subscriber and ultimate beneficial owner (passport copy, proof of residential address, professional reference)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC queries the charter for non-conformity with the Act's model form, the agent revises the deficient schedule, obtains a fresh subscriber execution by signature, and re-lodges within the query period. No additional government fee is charged for correction of a defective draft.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing of Form IC-1 and Payment of the Government Incorporation Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Registry Division, Port Vila, or the VFSC e-registry portal through the registered agent's secure filing facility.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent lodges Form IC-1 'Application for Registration as an International Company', together with the executed Memorandum and Articles, the registered agent's consent, and the statement of compliance. The USD 500 state fee is remitted by telegraphic transfer or from the agent's VFSC pre-funded escrow account. Upon approval, VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation stamped with the company number and date of incorporation, thereby creating the company with limited liability.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 Application for Registration as an International Company
Memorandum and Articles of Association as executed
Consent to act as Registered Agent
Statement of compliance of the registered agent
Proof of payment of the USD 500 government fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for procedural defects (e.g., unsigned schedule or incomplete compliance statement), the agent files an amendment or a fresh corrected application. VFSC typically cures the query within two business days after receipt of the compliant document; no additional fee is payable except where a wholly new application is required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting, Officer Appointments, and Opening of the Share Register
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: The Board of Directors, convened and minuted by the Company Secretary and the Registered Agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Immediately after issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation, the sole director passes the pro-forma first written board resolution ratifying incorporation, adopting the constitution, approving the subscription of the initial share, appointing the director and company secretary, and designating the registered office. The company secretary opens the register of members and the register of directors, records the allotment of the founding share, and issues the share certificate to the beneficial owner.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Memorandum and Articles of Association
First Board Resolution (written resolution)
Consent to act as Director and Consent to act as Company Secretary
Register of Members and Register of Directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an officer declines to act after appointment or a resolution defect is discovered, the board passes a ratifying resolution executed by all directors and records it in the minute book. In case of an officer resignation, a subsequent board resolution appoints a replacement and the company secretary files the applicable notification with the VFSC.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Confirmation of Registered Office and VFSC Beneficial Ownership Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registry Division and the VFSC-licensed Registered Agent maintaining the physical registered office at Port Vila.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered office remains at the licensed agent's address in Port Vila, Vanuatu. The agent files the notice of registered office and registered agent (Form IC-2) with the VFSC and prepares the beneficial ownership declaration containing particulars of the legal owner, directors, and any controlling person. The declaration is lodged within 14 days of incorporation under the Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Rules 2019. The company may thereafter proceed to open banking and payment processor accounts (Stripe, Shopify Payments) using the certificate of good standing and the constitutional documents.
required_dossiers: Form IC-2 Notice of Registered Office and Registered Agent
Beneficial Ownership Return (BO Form)
Consent forms of the beneficial owner, director, and company secretary
Certificate of Incorporation and certificate of good standing for banking and PSP onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late filing of the beneficial ownership return attracts a VFSC late-filing penalty; the cure is immediate submission of the BO Form accompanied by payment of the prescribed penalty. If the registered agent resigns, a successor licensed agent must be appointed within 21 days and Form IC-2 must be re-filed with the VFSC without delay.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable to a Vanuatu International Company conducting offshore trading only. An International Company is statutorily prohibited from carrying on business with Vanuatu residents, owning local land, or operating a physical domestic establishment; any on-island tailoring workshop or warehouse would instead require a domestic company incorporated under the Companies Act [Cap 191] and licensing by the Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Cooperatives, together with a municipal business license.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable. No Vanuatu operating permit, manufacturing license, or factory registration is required for the offshore International Company selling licensed theatrical costume robes and synthetic wigs through Stripe and Shopify Payments. If, in the future, a domestic Vanuatu subsidiary were established, it would require a 'Business License' issued by the Port Vila Municipality or other municipal authority and, for knitwear/textile production, a factory registration with the Department of Labour under workplace safety legislation.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Environment, Energy and Water.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 - Exempt. The offshore International Company triggers no EIA requirement because it has no local physical footprint. For any hypothetical on-shore domestic subsidiary, the activity would undergo environmental registration under the EIA Regulations 2017; small cut-and-sew tailoring of costumes and wigs normally qualifies as a Schedule 2 'no significant impact' screening exemption and does not require a full EIA Report.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to the offshore IC. For a hypothetical domestic facility, wastewater discharge must meet the effluent standards under the Environmental Protection and Conservation Act [Cap 283] and the Pollution Control Regulations (pH 6.0-8.5, BOD5 not exceeding 30 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 50 mg/L); solvent-based adhesive and wig-coating operations must maintain VOC fugitive emissions within DEPC occupational exposure limits, and spent solvents and textile waste must be stored and removed by a DEPC-approved waste contractor.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable to the offshore International Company. If a domestic subsidiary were later formed, the premises would require (i) a fire safety clearance certificate from the National Fire Service of the Vanuatu Police Force under the Fire Services Act [Cap 80]; (ii) building authorization and structural load inspection clearance from the Public Works Department; and (iii) workplace registration with the Department of Labour, including an OHS plan, fire exits, first aid provisions, machine guarding for sewing equipment, and particulate control for synthetic fibre dust.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), Inland Revenue Division, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management (MoFEM), Port Vila; official government portal: https://gov.vu (with VRC/ASYCUDA e-services modules)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: STEP 1 - Foreign beneficial owners incorporate the International Company through a licensed Registered Agent under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission issues the Certificate of Incorporation. STEP 2 - The Registered Agent lodges a taxpayer identification application with VRC; Vanuatu does not levy income tax, so the issued taxpayer number functions as the VAT/statistical identifier and is required for a Certificate of Tax Exemption. STEP 3 - The IC applies on Form VAT-01 (if it will transact or import in Vanuatu) for VAT registration; the certificate of incorporation, registered agent details, director/shareholder identity documents and local registered office address are attached. STEP 4 - The IC obtains a s. 52 International Companies Act Certificate of Tax Exemption from VRC, confirming a 20-year exemption from all Vanuatu taxes, duties and levies for offshore operations. STEP 5 - If show props or raw materials physically enter Vanuatu customs, the IC obtains an importer/exporter code in ASYCUDA World; for purely offshore e-commerce and overseas drop-ship sales, steps 3 and 5 are unnecessary.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election. Relevant elections for an International Company are: (1) election to apply the Companies Act [Cap. 191] governance rules in place of certain IC Act provisions; (2) election under s. 52 to hold a Certificate of Tax Exemption (20 years); (3) election to dispense with audited accounts; (4) election to redomicile to or from Vanuatu; (5) annual economic-substance self-classification election under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act/Rules, reserving offshore tax-exempt status for a pure IC with no relevant activity in Vanuatu.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT), Value Added Tax Act No. 14 of 1998; Vanuatu levies VAT rather than GST or a sales and use tax, and import duties under the Customs Act Cap. 145 are the only other indirect tax relevant to goods entering Vanuatu.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Compulsory registration for a person carrying on business in Vanuatu with annual taxable turnover above VUV 5,000,000 in a 12-month period (approx. USD 42,000); voluntary registration is open to exporters to claim input VAT credits. An offshore International Company manufacturing and delivering cosplay apparel outside Vanuatu does not cross a Vanuatu VAT nexus and is not required to register; nexus arises only on substantive Vanuatu establishment or on import of goods into Vanuatu.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandatory real-time e-invoicing, fiscal-API clearance or digital stamping regime exists in Vanuatu. VAT invoices must show the seller's TIN/VAT number, buyer, description, VAT-exclusive amount and 12.5% VAT. Export clearance is executed through the ASYCUDA World single-window customs system, which records the export declaration and serves as the evidential anchor for zero-rating; there is no pre-clearance invoice approval or continuous transaction control for B2B/B2C invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available under the VAT Act where (a) goods are exported from Vanuatu and leave the country, generally within 28 days of supply, supported by customs and shipping evidence; or (b) services are supplied to a non-resident and the benefit is enjoyed entirely outside Vanuatu. The cosplay prop/apparel manufacturing business qualifies either as non-scope (goods manufactured and sold overseas) or zero-rated export if goods physically pass through Vanuatu. Input VAT incurred locally (sampling, prototypes, design services, freight) is creditable in proportion to documented zero-rated export sales.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World export entry, with the HS code corresponding to ISIC 3240 manufactured theatrical wear/props)
Bill of Lading, Sea Waybill or Air Waybill evidencing physical departure of the goods from Vanuatu
Inward Remittance Certificate (bank MT103/SWIFT credit confirmation or foreign exchange conversion certificate evidencing receipt of export payment)
VAT zero-rating claim form (export schedule prescribed by VRC) with underlying purchase invoices and forwarder receipts
International Company Certificate of Incorporation and valid Certificate of Tax Exemption
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu has no exchange-control enactment, so the 180-day repatriation benchmark is a commercial/bank standard rather than a statute deadline. Unsubstantiated zero-rating claims are recharacterized as domestic taxable supplies, permitting a 5-year retrospective assessment of 12.5% VAT plus interest. Civil penalties range from 50% to 200% of the tax shortfall; corporate fines can reach VUV 5,000,000; directors, officers and the Registered Agent risk imprisonment of up to 2 years for fraudulent declarations. Misuse of an International Company tax exemption or economic-substance self-certification triggers revocation of the Certificate of Tax Exemption and VFSC deregistration. In addition, Vanuatu's inclusion on the EU list of non-cooperative jurisdictions and the OECD/EOIR standards requires full beneficial-ownership, transfer-pricing and export-documentation trails, and artificial arrangements designed merely to obtain zero-rating are susceptible to general anti-avoidance challenge.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 125], acting as the sole monetary authority and regulator of licensed financial institutions in the Republic of Vanuatu.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains a fully liberalized capital and current account regime. The Exchange Control Act has been effectively abrogated; no exchange control approval is required for inward capital subscription, outward profit remittance, dividend distribution, or trade settlement by an International Company (IC). The Vatu (VUV) is a floating currency, not freely traded offshore, but resident and non-resident entities may freely hold, convert, and transfer VUV and foreign currency accounts. Profit remittance to shareholders is subject to zero withholding tax under the IC's Tax-Exempt Zone classification; the only practical friction is correspondent bank compliance rather than statutory RBV restriction.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender obligation exists. Exporters of manufactured goods (including cosplay prop apparel) may retain 100% of foreign currency proceeds in onshore or offshore foreign-currency accounts indefinitely. There is no mandated conversion of USD, AUD, or EUR receipts into VUV, and no RBV declaration or permitting step is required for repatriation of trade receivables. ICs are additionally prohibited from conducting domestic business with Vanuatu residents, which reinforces that proceeds must derive exclusively from export or offshore commercial activity.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Multi-Currency Operational Account (VUV/USD/AUD) for trade settlements and treasury transactions

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Offshore Business Account (USD-denominated) with internet banking and SWIFT connectivity
Corporate Foreign Currency Account (USD/EUR) for IC treasury operations
VUV Domestic Operating Account (not recommended for offshore IC treasury)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Low-Medium. Vanuatu International Companies face elevated de-risking scrutiny from offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex) due to the jurisdiction's historical tax-haven classification and thin correspondent banking footprint; most mainstream EMIs either decline VU-incorporated entities outright or impose multi-tier enhanced due diligence. Direct Stripe and Shopify Payments onboarding is also unsupported for a Vanuatu-domiciled merchant, so the practical architecture is: (i) anchor a physical USD account with BSP or ANZ; (ii) route e-commerce settlement through a supported intermediate payment facilitator or a US/UK sales entity; and (iii) use the EMI only as a pre-funded disbursement wallet, never as primary treasury storage.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is permissible in principle. ANZ and BSP accept certified true copies of IC incorporation documents, the Certificate of Incumbency, and a Privacy Act/registered agent certificate, provided the beneficial owner(s) complete a mandatory live video interview and the registered agent countersigns the account application; however, in practice both banks frequently request one director to attend an in-person meeting at a Port Vila branch to validate identity when the ownership structure is fully non-resident, unless the applicant provides a recent audited financial statement and strong banker's reference. Allow 2-4 weeks for approval, with an additional 5-10 business days for SWIFT/BIC activation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Jurisdiction risk profile: Vanuatu IC identified as a zero-tax offshore structure, triggering FATF/unilateral EU de-risking filters at the onboarding underwriting stage.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Good Standing from Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); certified copy of the IC's constitution evidencing no domestic business; substantive business plan detailing cosplay costume manufacturing and export; purchase orders or distribution agreements with counterparties; and if available, audited financial statements proving real economic activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident beneficial owners residing in high-risk or sanctioned-adjacent jurisdictions, or unclear source of funds for initial share capital.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source of Wealth and Source of Funds declarations with supporting bank statements; passport copy and proof of residential address; professional reference letter from a licensed lawyer/accountant; confirmations of non-PEP status or full PEP disclosure in accordance with the Vanuatu AML/CFT Act and the AML/CFT Procedures Directive.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: IP/trademark red flag: the manufacture of licensed theatrical costume robes and synthetic wigs may be flagged for counterfeit/licensing ambiguity by the bank's transaction monitoring when receiving Stripe/Shopify settlement flows.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed trademark license or merchandising agreements from IP rights holders; product catalog and licensee reference codes; royalty payment schedules evidencing legitimate authorization; invoices and shipping documents matching goods sold to licensed inventory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Lack of physical nexus with Vanuatu: non-resident directors and sole foreign manufacturing operations cause relationship managers to question economic substance and beneficial ownership traceability.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered office address certificate; registered agent engagement letter; short-term office lease or sub-lease in Port Vila (if any); director appointment resolutions; organizational chart evidencing management oversight; bank reference letters from existing financial relationships in manufacturing jurisdictions.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital injections should be wired via SWIFT MT103 from the beneficial owner's personal or corporate account to the IC's USD account at BSP or ANZ with the word 'Share Capital Subscription' and the IC registration number in the remittance information field. No RBV approval or exchange control form is required; however, the receiving bank will require an advance copy of the capital introduction letter and the IC constitution's share issuance resolution to classify the credit as non-export revenue. Avoid lump-sum cash-equivalent transactions and always source funds from the same jurisdiction/bank as declared in the KYC file to prevent a 'split-transfer' flag.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rail is SWIFT MT103 for direct supplier payments (e.g., raw fabric, wig fiber, and hardware procured from China/Hong Kong/Vietnam), settled in USD or CNY depending on the supplier's bank's willingness to accept USD. For large procurement orders, a confirmed Commercial Letter of Credit (L/C at sight) issued by ANZ/BSP and advised through a Chinese or Vietnamese confirming bank is recommended to secure shipping terms; for lower-value disbursements, the IC should use bank-to-bank telegraphic transfer (TT) with full invoice and packing list cross-referenced in the payment narrative to avoid trade-based money laundering (TBML) flags. E-commerce settlement from Stripe/Shopify should not be drawn directly into the Vanuatu bank account; instead, settle into the supported payment facilitator's holding structure and sweep daily to the USD account via automated payout.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) referencing VUV/USD executed offshore, given the absence of an active onshore forward market
Plain-vanilla FX forwards and swaps with ANZ or BSP for conversions between USD, AUD, and EUR balances held in Vanuatu
Cross-currency swaps (USD/CNY) to hedge imported raw materials, noting the Chinese counterparty leg will be subject to China's FX control and requires a trade-backed documentary justification

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: VFSC Annual Government Retention Fee (International Company annual license payment)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 June for the standard VFSC renewal cycle; new incorporations after 1 July may be pro-rated to the next 30 June.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment attracts penalty interest of approximately 10% per annum on the outstanding fee; persistent non-payment triggers administrative strike-off after formal VFSC notice. Directors remain jointly and severally liable for company debts until reinstatement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership and Registered Details Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submitted contemporaneously with the annual fee cycle, on or before 30 June or the registered agent's designated anniversary confirmation date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance with UBO and registered details requirements is an offence under Vanuatu AML/CFT legislation; penalties include fines of up to VUV 100,000 (approximately USD 850) and, upon conviction, imprisonment of responsible officers. Persistent failure may additionally result in administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit threshold applies to a standard tax-exempt International Company. An independent statutory audit becomes mandatory only if the company holds a VFSC financial services license, is admitted to a securities exchange, or is otherwise subject to sector-specific licensing conditions such as insurance or money services.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory accounting framework is prescribed for a non-licensed International Company. Where financial statements are voluntarily prepared, IFRS or a simple internal cash-basis GAAP is acceptable absent a licensing requirement.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed registered agent must hold a current beneficial ownership register and provide an annual UBO confirmation to the VFSC with the annual renewal. Any shareholding transfer that changes the register of members or UBO is to be notified to the registered agent within the update cycle, with the agent confirming the updated register before the next annual confirmation.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 if audit is not required; USD 3,000 – USD 8,000 if a voluntary certified audit is procured for a cosplay costume manufacturing entity

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax under domestic law; neither resident companies nor International Companies (ICs) are subject to a national corporate profits tax.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Nil effective rate. An IC registered under the International Companies Act (Cap. 191) is statutorily exempt from Vanuatu income tax, capital gains tax, dividend/interest/royalty withholding tax, stamp duty and estate duty in respect of its international business. Export sales of cosplay costumes and synthetic wigs are zero-rated or outside the scope of Vanuatu VAT (standard rate 15%); no payroll tax, branch profits tax, or net wealth tax applies. The only recurring fiscal burdens are the VFSC annual fee, the annual business licence tariff (where any domestic nexus exists) and, if local taxable supplies are made, VAT compliance.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Return under the International Companies Act (Cap. 191) filed with the Registrar of International Companies at the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); filed electronically via the VFSC online filing portal or through a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return is due within the statutory period following each anniversary of incorporation (administered as a 30-day filing window); the annual government fee is payable simultaneously. No extension is available for non-resident convenience.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Item 1 — Company name and VFSC registration number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name and International Company number as shown on the certificate of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Complete in English; do not translate the legal name; the registration number must match the certificate to avoid rejection.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Item 2 — Registered office address in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the VFSC-licensed registered agent in Vanuatu; a PO Box alone is not acceptable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders cannot substitute a foreign address; the resident agent's office is the statutory registered office and service-of-process point.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and licence number of the Vanuatu-licensed registered agent maintaining the statutory register.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent attests compliance; non-resident principals execute a signed engagement letter with the agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full name, residential address, nationality, date of birth and consent for each director (minimum one natural or corporate director).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors of any nationality are permitted; director consents must be notarially certified where executed offshore.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, address, class and number of shares held by each member; bearer shares must be immobilised and declared.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Beneficial ownership must be documented for VFSC and AML purposes; UBO details are held by the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued capital, par value and currency of issue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital applies; the statement must reconcile with the register of members.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Item 7 — Declaration of no domestic business
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification that the IC carried on no Vanuatu domestic business and earned no Vanuatu-source income, preserving the tax-exempt international status.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Online sales into Vanuatu by the IC, or local warehousing, would breach this declaration; use an arm's-length local distributor if local delivery is required.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers tiered VFSC surcharges escalating monthly while the default continues; non-payment of the annual fee leads to automatic strike-off and dissolution of the IC. A struck-off company cannot hold Stripe or Shopify Payments merchant accounts, enforce contracts, or distribute dividends; restoration requires court intervention and settlement of arrears.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Business Licence Application/Renewal under the Business Licence Act (Cap. 194) filed with the Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) / Department of Industry business licence office; renewal is accepted via the official application form and, where enabled, the electronic licensing channel.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Licences run on the calendar year; renewal must be submitted before 31 December for the licence to be valid from 1 January of the following year. Late renewal attracts an incremental penalty and materially delays merchant-account KYC re-validation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Trading name of the IC or its e-commerce brand and prior licence reference.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the exact entity name or registered brand; an IC trading under a different trade name must record that name.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Sector code mapping to ISIC/NACE equivalent; for cosplay costumery use the manufacturing/retail classification covering ISIC 3240 activities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Classification determines the licence fee band; mis-description to reduce fees is an offence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Vanuatu business premises or, for out-of-country operators, the address of the licensed agent/local representative.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If no domestic place of business exists, declare 'internationally operated' and name a service-of-process address in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Projected gross revenue band for the licence year used to calculate the annual fee.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the worldwide turnover of the IC only to the extent allocable to the licensed activity; under-declaration triggers reassessment and penalties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Trading without a licence is an offence carrying fines per day of default; the regulator may suspend the entity. Business-licence records are routinely queried by licensed payment processors, causing payout freezes; renewal is also a precondition for continued VFSC annual-return comfort.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT registration and periodic Value Added Tax return under the Value Added Tax Act (Cap. 248), administered by the Commissioner of Inland Revenue (Department of Customs and Inland Revenue); applicable only if the IC makes taxable supplies within Vanuatu above the registration threshold or voluntarily registers.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Quarterly (monthly at the Commissioner's discretion for larger registrants)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Returns are due within the prescribed period after the end of each taxable period (standard quarterly cycle ending 31 March, 30 June, 30 September and 31 December); payment accompanies the return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique Vanuatu VAT number; period covered by the return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Applies only where local sales occur; pure export e-commerce remains unregistered or zero-rated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable supplies, zero-rated export supplies and exempt supplies with VAT computed at the 15% standard rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Export shipments of cosplay apparel must be substantiated by carrier waybills, customs declarations and consumer-address evidence to support zero-rating.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Recoverable VAT on local purchases used for taxable supplies; import VAT on materials is recoverable if goods are re-exported.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign supplier invoices without Vanuatu VAT are not deductible; apportionment is required where local sales co-exist with exports.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Net tax payable / credit carried forward
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Excess input credits are carried forward or refunded in cash at the Commissioner's discretion.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident IC in a refund position should evidence the absence of a permanent establishment before claiming a cash refund.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to register despite a taxable presence triggers back-assessment, misdeclaration penalties and interest; late filing and late payment surcharges accrue automatically; wilful evasion is a criminal offence carrying fines and imprisonment.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu has no dividend withholding tax; a Vanuatu IC can distribute untaxed international profits to foreign shareholders without deduction at source, and no advance dividend tax or dividend tax balance arises.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu does not maintain a general network of comprehensive Double Taxation Agreements; it has entered Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) focused on transparency rather than withholding-tax relief. Accordingly, no standard treaty-relief application or tax residency certificate submission exists for outbound dividends. If an exceptional bilateral instrument were invoked, the claimant would (i) obtain a tax residency certificate from the residence state, (ii) procure a binding ruling from the Commissioner of Inland Revenue, and (iii) execute a sponsor letter from the Vanuatu payor; in ordinary cosplay manufacturing structures the 0% domestic withholding rate makes a TRC submission unnecessary.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: interest 0% and royalties 0% — Vanuatu imposes no domestic withholding tax on cross-border interest or IP royalties. No DTA rate reduction is required; however, intellectual property rents (brand-licence fees, costume-design IP) must be commercially substantiated so that no disguised-profit or substance challenge arises.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no transfer-pricing statute; there is no Local File or Master File threshold (nil VUV filing duty) because there is no corporate income tax base to allocate. Cross-border transactions with related factories or brand owners should nonetheless be documented at arm's length as best practice and to preserve integrity in any Economic Substance review.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. Vanuatu amended the International Companies Act to introduce Economic Substance Requirements administered by the VFSC, aligning with OECD standards. A Vanuatu IC performing a relevant activity — notably 'distribution and service centre', 'holding business', or 'intellectual property business' — must demonstrate (i) physical presence and premises in Vanuatu, (ii) full-time employees proportionate to the activity, (iii) core income-generating activities performed in Vanuatu, and (iv) adequate local expenditure; an annual economic substance declaration is required. For the ISIC 3240 cosplay apparel structure, physical contract manufacturing typically occurs offshore; the IC's local function is limited, so B2C online retail to unrelated customers should fall outside the relevant-activity definition, but a written position paper should be filed with the substance declaration. Purchasing from a related factory and reselling to related distributors would trigger the substance test.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax evasion via false tax-exemption claims / VAT fraud
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsely treating Vanuatu domestic sales as exports, fabricating shipping documents to zero-rate VAT, under-declaring turnover in business licence and VAT declarations, or earning Vanuatu-source income while invoking the IC tax exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Back-assessment of 15% VAT plus statutory interest and misdeclaration penalties (commonly up to 100% of the tax), disqualification from the IC regime, licence cancellation, and criminal fines; persistent fraud leads to prosecution and imprisonment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced for knowing participation: directors are jointly and severally liable for assessed tax and penalties, exposed to restitution orders, criminal conviction, and, where proceedings risk flight, travel bans and asset-freezing orders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the IC as a bare nominee vehicle with offshore decision-making, no Vanuatu employees, no records, no substance declaration, or falsely declaring a relevant activity as non-relevant to avoid the ESR filing while the entity in fact conducts distribution or IP-holding functions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC monetary penalties for false declaration, administrative strike-off and dissolution, loss of the IC's statutory tax benefit, and regulatory referral to OECD/EU listing mechanisms endangering the entity's banking and payment-rail relationships.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners face disqualification orders, administrative financial penalties, unfitness declarations taking effect across Vanuatu's regulated sectors, and personal liability for debts of the shell if it traded while unable to meet obligations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating Stripe and Shopify Payments proceeds flows without a documented AML/CFT framework, omitting customer due diligence on high-value orders, accepting virtual assets without licensing, structuring transactions to avoid reporting thresholds, or using bearer shares without registration of beneficial owners.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Prosecution under the Proceeds of Crime Act and Vanuatu's AML/CFT statutory framework: confiscation of proceeds, monetary penalties, suspension of the entity's licence, and imprisonment at the higher end for intentional money laundering.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Senior managers and the AML compliance officer are personally accountable; sanctions include criminal conviction, travel bans pending seizure proceedings, personal bankruptcy orders, and civil restitution to defrauded stakeholders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure of annual return / fee / substance filing discipline
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Omitting the VFSC annual return, non-payment of annual fees, or late filing of the economic substance declaration because the registered agent was not instructed.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Escalating monthly late fees, automatic strike-off and dissolution, forfeiture of assets to the State as bona vacantia, and permanent loss of the ability to operate Stripe or Shopify Payments merchant accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who continued to trade after strike-off are personally liable for contracts entered in the company's name, may be sued by creditors, and are barred from acting as directors of any Vanuatu company without court leave.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling into Vanuatu consumers via Shopify or Stripe without a business licence, representing a non-existent local establishment in the licence application, or routing domestic sales through an offshore payment account to evade licence and VAT duties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines per day of unlicensed trading, closure of the payment account by the regulator, VAT assessments with penalties, and director prosecution; acquirers may blacklist the entity's KYC profile.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorised the payment integration and the local representative who certified the licence application are personally jointly liable for fines and restitution; travel restrictions may be imposed pending resolution of the assessment.
